section.heading: Persons to whom this Part applies

content.p: This Part applies to a person if:
either:
the person is a member; or
the person is a former member but the person was a member at any time on or after 1 December 1988; and
the person has not made a claim of a kind referred to in paragraph 319(1)(a); and
the person is included in a class of persons determined in an instrument under section 53D; and
the Commission has determined, in writing, that this Part applies to the person.
A determination under paragraph (1)(d) is not a legislative instrument.
The member or former member need not have sustained a service injury or contracted a service disease.
(4) Sections 7, 8 and 9 of the Military Rehabilitation and Compensation (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Act 2004 do not apply for the purposes of this Part.

The rehabilitation authority for a person to whom this Part applies must make arrangements with an approved program provider for the provision of a rehabilitation program for the person that consists of either or both of the following:
vocational assessment and rehabilitation;
psycho-social training.
For the purposes of designing or providing the rehabilitation program:

the rehabilitation authority or approved program provider concerned may seek the assistance of persons with suitable qualifications or expertise in the design or provision of rehabilitation programs; and
the rehabilitation authority or approved program provider concerned may take into account any relevant information of which it is aware or that is brought to its attention.
Conditions and limits
A rehabilitation program under this section is subject to:
the conditions in relation to the provision of the program that are determined in an instrument under section 53D; and
the limits (whether financial or otherwise) in relation to the provision of the program that are determined in that instrument.
Cost of rehabilitation program to be paid by Commonwealth
The cost of a rehabilitation program under this section is to be paid by the Commonwealth.
Section 38 does not apply
Section 38 does not apply for the purposes of this Part.
The Commission may, by legislative instrument:
determine a class of persons for the purposes of paragraph 53B(1)(c); and
determine conditions in relation to the provision of a rehabilitation program for the purposes of paragraph 53C(3)(a); and
determine limits (whether financial or otherwise) in relation to the provision of a rehabilitation program for the purposes of paragraph 53C(3)(b).

Without limiting subsection (1), a determination under that subsection may make provision for and in relation to an approved program provider or the Commission being satisfied of one or more specified matters.
